hypothesis: Ghost users commission bounded migration/import repairs that our existing diagnostic work could support.

marketplace_rule.quote: Advertise or request commercial services for Ghost, like apps, jobs, premium themes, hosting or consulting.

marketplace_listing.observation: Of 30 latest topics, 28 are vendor/theme/hosting advertisements; buyer-authored requests: 63458 (2026-07-29). Latest buyer migration request found by search is 57157 (2025-04-28); earlier ones date 2019-2021.

access_and_rules.submission_prerequisite: Replying or messaging needs a forum account; blocker NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT (open, needs_founder). Not probed.

candidates.author: dan
candidates.quote: $999/year gets you ongoing help (calls plus small fixes), or project work for themes, migrations, and custom stuff.
candidates.reason: Vendor advertisement (supply side), not buyer demand. Shows that an incumbent prices migration work inside a USD 999/year retainer.

candidates.author: pops
candidates.quote: I’m looking for someone with experience to assist me in implementing the best strategy to merge two websites together in Ghost.
candidates.requested_outcome: Theme/homepage build plus a domain merge of a WP site onto an existing Ghost stack (18K+ subs, Stripe); the author says “I don’t want to migrate them over”.
candidates.status: open topic, last post 2025-04-28 (over 18 months old; resolution unobservable)
candidates.reason: Stale. The scope is theme/design/DNS/proxy work, not an import repair; it needs live site access and design work outside our offline tools.

candidates.author: jujujampada
candidates.quote: Embed a checkout/buy-button system (e.g. Payhip or Snipcart) into individual Ghost book pages via code injection
candidates.requested_outcome: E-book storefront and checkout integration with member coupon logic
candidates.budget: not quoted; a reply mentions a “bonus-based compensation plan”
candidates.reason: Not migration/import. Needs third-party checkout accounts and live site access; compensation is unclear and contingent.

summary: 0 of 3 buyer-side candidates is a paid Ghost migration/import repair we could deliver offline. On the public Marketplace, supply (vendors, Ghost Experts, hosting firms that offer migrations) far outnumbers buyer requests. Observed buyer requests are theme/integration builds needing live access.
uncertainties: Only public Marketplace topics and one search were read; private DMs, the Ghost Experts directory and off-forum hiring are unobserved.
Topic resolution is not observable from the public JSON.
Our Ghost converter remains unvalidated upstream (upstream-execution/result.json); this limits any import-repair offer regardless of demand.
next: Close this bounded experiment; do not widen Ghost discovery. Reopen only on a classified inbound request or an approved forum account.
